scope: A dimensioned pinhole chamber illustrating the experiment described on D8r. Its compact box size is a modern teaching interpretation of Leonardo’s darkened room.
gaps: Leonardo supplies no room depth or aperture diameter here.
Not an anatomical reconstruction of Leonardo’s theory of the eye.
No image-specific holder licence quote obtained.

folio.catalogue_reference: Institut de France Ms2175, folio8r. Folio transcription checked in e-leo.

motion.visitor_12s: The chamber itself is still and has no joint to move. What crosses in twelve seconds is the lit source outside the aperture, and with it the projected image on the paper, the opposite way. Any cutaway visibility is a presentation mode and must not be represented as a light-leaking working chamber.

animation_notes: Do not animate a mechanism missing from the evidence.
Use straight ray projection through the aperture, not a lens.
For a virtual source plane3 m before the aperture, map source coordinates (x,y) relative to aperture centre to screen coordinates(-x/6,-y/6). This is an optical rendering rule, not moving geometry.
If a wall is hidden to show the interior, explain that the physical experiment requires darkness.

The lit source and its projected image are modern demonstration furniture outside the dossier parts. They carry no certainty claim about Leonardo's own apparatus and must not be added to the parts list or to the certified footprint.
No photographic film, permanent recording, double inversion inside an anatomical eye, or powered projector.

sheet_vs_reconstruction: [folio] A small round hole in very thin iron admits images into darkness, where thin white paper receives them.
[geometry] The1.2 m chamber,2 mm hole and0.5 m screen distance are modern assumptions. Leonardo describes a room, not this portable box.

[geometry] The chamber is built the way a joiner of about 1500 would build a dark box: vertical oak boards nailed to four corner posts and to battens inside, a boarded floor and roof, the front set back between the sides, the iron plate nailed over a square opening, and the paper pasted on a light frame sliding in guides. None of this construction is on the sheet.

dimensions.note: [folio] Qualitative thickness only. No numerical braccio dimension or Richter number verified.

claims.claimed_by_leonardo: [folio] Demonstrate intersecting image rays and compare them with vision.
claims.tested_by_leonardo: No direct test record established in the inspected sources.
claims.built_in_lifetime: [folio] The text gives an experiment and observable outcome. It is not evidence for a surviving camera built by Leonardo.
later_tests: No instrument-specific modern replica test was established. The pinhole construction follows straight-line geometrical optics.

physics.formula: Magnification m = -b/a. Projected height h_i=m*h_o. Geometric blur diameter c = d*(1+b/a).

inputs.note: Modern model distance from the aperture plane to the paper image plane.
Assumed distance from the object plane to the aperture plane, on the incoming-light side.
Assumed object height in the object plane.
Modern model diameter of the circular aperture, used in the geometric blur calculation.

physics.result: m=-0.5/3=-1/6. A1.8 m object forms an inverted0.30 m image. Geometric aperture blur c=.002*(1+.5/3)=.002333 m, about2.3 mm. Diffraction, illumination and finite object depth omitted.
physics.limitations: This arithmetic is a conditional illustration, not an experimental result.
physics.verdict_en: At the assumed distances, a 1.8 metre object makes an inverted image 0.30 metres high.
physics.verdict_de: Bei den angenommenen Abständen wird ein 1,8 Meter hohes Objekt als umgekehrtes Bild von 0,30 Metern Höhe sichtbar.

myths.claim: Leonardo invented photography or all camera obscura principles.
myths.earliest_source_located: [historical]1911 account points to Venturi’s1797 notice of the manuscript. This is the earliest located publication trail, not a proven first invention claim.
myths.correction: [folio] A projected image is not a permanent photographic record. The note does not establish invention of the earlier optical principle.

research.confidence: High for identified text and optical principle. All physical dimensions modern assumptions.
